svg.text: Norsk Data ND-5000 ES Model C

middle: cards plug in from both sides

Cutaway: left side, roof and the front cover over the card area removed. Layout from ND-830102 figures 15 and 16; which cards sit where across the width is schematic.
Sources: ND-830102 ES Model C Hardware Maintenance Manual (ND-830102-1-EN.pdf), chapter 2; shell size from the 1987 planning manual.
Colour: the Compact colours are used; the new ES front cover and its colour are not documented or photographed.
